title: New Mannich-type arylidenerhodanines as potent inhibitors of AChE and BChE: synthesis, biological evaluation, cytotoxicity and molecular modeling
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,50186-50205
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07416A, Paper
Open Access

Feyzi Sinan Tokalı, Halil Şenol, Yeliz Demir, Orhan Uluçay, Mubashir Ameen, Zahid Shafiq
Mannich-type rhodanine derivatives showed potent AChE/BChE inhibition with low cytotoxicity, supported by strong and stable binding modes, highlighting their potential for Alzheimer's therapy.
